meaning:
ὀφείλημα, -τος, τό
(ὀφείλω), [in LXX: Deu.24:10 (מַשָּׁאָה), I Est.3:20, 1Ma.15:8 * ;]
that which is owed, a debt: Rom.4:4; metaphorically (as Aram. חוֺבָא חוֺב), of sin as a debt, Mat.6:12.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
